artifacts.summary: 7-phase plan for a topic-scoped literature coverage-delta guard: shared term-match helper extraction, a new literature-coverage-delta.sh, resolver + briefing wiring, Stage 4a flow update, Section H fixtures, and docs.

memory_candidates.content: When adding a new degradation signal to an existing marker/banner family, two design rules recur in this codebase: (1) fold the signal into an already-polled channel OR give it its own consumer on day one -- a new field nothing greps reproduces the silent-degradation failure it exists to close; overloading an existing boolean is only correct when the two conditions call for the SAME operator action, otherwise add distinct fields plus an always-emitted banner. (2) Never let 'not computed' render as a zero: carry an explicit checked=true|false companion field so an uncomputed value cannot be misread as a verified clean result. Both rules were applied when extending the literature --lit sparse-coverage family with a cross-index coverage delta.
